name: Lifestyle Lodge
description: Lifestyle Lodge is a self-catering holiday home on the Flamingo Land Resort that sleeps six, with theme park and zoo access included. The resort has no hotel, so the on-site lodges are the closest place to stay. Rates shown are estimates.

rooms.name: Lifestyle Lodge (sleeps 6)
rooms.description: Self-catering lodge for a family or group of six.

name: The Gate House
description: The Gate House sits on the edge of the resort next to Penguin Coast, sleeps five and has a hot tub. A different, private option for a family stay at Flamingo Land. Rates shown are estimates.

rooms.name: The Gate House (sleeps 5)
rooms.description: Self-catering house with a hot tub, sleeping five.

name: Best Western Forest & Vale Hotel
description: The Best Western Forest & Vale Hotel is in Pickering, roughly 3 to 5 miles from Flamingo Land. A comfortable hotel base with a rate of around £144 for a sample night. Rates shown are estimates.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Room with extra beds for families.

name: The White Swan Inn
description: The White Swan Inn is a coaching inn on Market Place in Pickering, about 2.8 miles from Flamingo Land. Rates found online range from about £120 to £219 a night. Rates shown are estimates.

rooms.name: Double Room
rooms.description: Comfortable double room at the inn.

name: The Talbot Hotel
description: The Talbot Hotel is in Malton, about 5 miles from Flamingo Land, a more upmarket base in a historic market town. Rates found online start at around £103 to £117 a night. Rates shown are estimates.
